question: Does one fixed asymmetric signed-regret discount improve residual wet exact-turn decisions at matched charged work without materially degrading the known dry game?
scope: two already outcome-inspected known turn-start games; no unseen, population, or default claim
control: immutable published signed_full_exact_turn_river paths; no control retraining
candidate: same exact turn/river full expected learner with only owned signed-regret discount after each target update at t>=2

candidate_regret_update.initialization: unchanged exact uniform two-pass initialization charged to work
candidate_regret_update.average: unchanged opponent-pass chance-own-reach linear t weight
candidate_regret_update.traversal: full expected, every visited node charged including zero reach
candidate_regret_update.rng: PCG64(0) explicit and unused by full traversal

primary_metric: final linear-average exact restricted-game NashConv/2 in chips and fraction of each loaded 36-chip initial pot; lower is better
report: all 24 policies, paired deltas, both-seat/turn/river gains, fixed decisions, positive-average coverage, recall, work, bytes, runtime, peak RSS and deterministic dependence/limits

classification.positive: both candidate absolute gates pass; wet candidate-minus-control <= -0.001 pot and dry candidate-minus-control <= +0.001 pot
classification.negative: either candidate absolute gate fails, or wet or dry candidate-minus-control > +0.001 pot

profile.assignment: wet worker zero, dry worker one
profile.estimate_per_game: maximum of three complete whole_path_seconds * 10000000 / actual_final_work
profile.T: larger of the two fixed game maxima

native.control_audits: verify pinned already published independent scalar audits; no new control training

publication: prospective protocol before candidate outcomes; isolated exact-source local/optional/hosted before fictional proof; proof before fixed profile; complete profile before separate data-only admission; own before comparison-only native; report before final exact-source checks/review/history merge
stop_rule: one admitted two-candidate-path study; correctness, source, numerical, publication, compute or time failure stops measurement with partials; a failed poker-strength or coverage gate is classified negative after required audits; no changed work, parameters, spot, seed or favorable scientific retry
